answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by binding voting power to capital, forcing attackers to acquire expensive tokens rather than spawning a hollow army of fake identities. An adversary attempting to overwhelm a network faces costs akin to melting a glacier through sheer computation; the economic barrier renders malicious subversion unprofitable. Like light filtering through violet glass, individual credentials are verified via staked collateral, ensuring that each node's influence is anchored in tangible, risked resources.
